text:
elaine: Heads-up: CI is failing for sdk-bootstrap sampleapp after the last typegen change. semver guard is rejecting the publish.

 tian: Which package? paste the regen diff?

 elaine: samples/sdk-bootstrap

 elaine: Repro:
 ```
 # locally
 git checkout main
 yarn install
 yarn regen -p samples/sdk-bootstrap
 git status --porcelain
 ```

 elaine: Error snippet in CI:
 ```
 Error: semver guard failed for @redwood/sdk-bootstrap
 Expected: 0.2.3 -> 0.2.4 (patch)
 Actual: 0.2.3 -> 0.3.0 (minor)
 Run 'yarn typegen:inspect' for details
 ```

 dev-bot: :robot_face: CI failed (pipeline 4823) - see logs https://ci.internal/4823

 samir: I think this is the same ordering change we saw — typegen emitted a reordered enum which bumped the version. There's a small nondet in openapi property sort.

 lina: Confirmed. The regen diff shows only property order in generated model for PaymentMethod. No behavior change.

 samir: Quick options:
 - revert the typegen sorting change
 - add a semver override for samples until we stabilize
 - make typegen deterministic by using stable sort key (id then name)

 tian: Can we patch the typegen to stable sort? I can open a PR but need a reproduce unit test.

 elaine: Created a minimal repro test in tools/tests/typegen_order.test.ts

 elaine: Test output:
 ```
 - expected: enum ["card","bank","cash"]
 - actual:   enum ["bank","card","cash"]
 ```

 lina: Also the sample's integration test sometimes flakes because auth/retry stamping changes timestamps in generated client fixtures. That made changelog extractor pick up a diff.

 samir: Ugh. Two orthogonal flaps. Lina: can we normalize fixture timestamps in tests? maybe mock Date.now?

 lina: Yeah mocking Date.now in sample harness fixes the churn.

 tian: I'll do stable-sort patch + test. Can we relax semver guard for samples so we can land hotfix? maybe add file .semver-exempt for samples/* until next release.

 elaine: For now I pushed a temporary fix in CI: set OPENAPI_SORT=stable for regen step. PR: #4423

 ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Pipeline 4823 retriggered by @elaine - now passing (regen step) but semver guard still flagged because package.json bump still reflects minor.

 samir: Now run: `node tools/normalize-package-version.js samples/sdk-bootstrap` to revert package.json to patch.

 elaine: Done. Pushed commit and updated CHANGELOG ordering so extractor is happy. Will merge once CI green.

 tian: Thanks — follow-up: add an integration test to catch unordered enum diffs in regen-diff CI job.

 lina: I'll also add Date mocking to sample harness before end of week.

 elaine: TL;DR: root cause = nondeterministic openapi property ordering + test fixtures with live timestamps. Fixes: stable sort in typegen + mock Date in harness + temp CI env OPENAPI_SORT=stable. Semver adjusted to patch. :party:

 samir: Nice. Can someone add a note to devex runbook about regen-diff flakiness?

 elaine: Added note in docs: docs/devex/regen-flakiness.md

 dev-bot: :hammer_and_wrench: Created ticket DX-1297 to track permanent fixes.

 elaine: assigning to @tian and @lina
